commit 2e13caf966fb0b485edb7fe36ac5b7c78dd6c4ef
Author:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 7 13:01:31 2026 +0000
Commit:     kaie@kuix.de <kaie@kuix.de>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 7 13:03:46 2026 +0000

    Bug 2053082 - Don't ignore .orig files. r=kaie
    
    Mercurial generates .orig files in case of conflicts, which Git doesn't do.
    
    As a coincidence, Cargo may also generate .orig files when vendoring deps. This
    means we end up with files for which we have checksums to check but which don't
    exist in the tree.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310794

diff --git a/.gitignore b/.gitignore
index 1a4abed3014..9b84df15942 100644
--- a/.gitignore
+++ b/.gitignore
@@ -50,8 +50,4 @@ third_party/asn1js/node_modules/
 rust/target/
 rust/ms_graph_tb/ms_graph_tb_extract/target/
 
-# Generated by hg or patch (e.g. revert, failed patch, ...)
-*.orig
-*.rej
-
 
diff --git a/third_party/rust/operation-queue/Cargo.toml.orig b/third_party/rust/operation-queue/Cargo.toml.orig
index 4b0e6bcbc07..0bebe91ac58 100644
--- a/third_party/rust/operation-queue/Cargo.toml.orig
+++ b/third_party/rust/operation-queue/Cargo.toml.orig
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 [package]
 name = "operation-queue"
-version = "1.1.0"
+version = "1.2.0"
 edition = "2024"
 description = "Helpers for synchronizing asynchronous protocol operations."
 categories = ["asynchronous"]
title: Bug 2053082 - Don't ignore .orig files. r=kaie
